# Test-only official MCP SDK acceptance dependencies.
# MCP SDK pin remains 2.2.0 from the 2026-09-13 refresh. Use a separate venv.
# Wheel hashes from official PyPI version metadata, checked 2026-10-19.
# cffi, pydantic-core, rpds-py, and pywin32 are cp315 wheels. cryptography
# stays on its 50.0.1 abi3 wheels, which the regular CPython 3.15 build
# selects. pydantic 2.14.1 requires pydantic-core==2.50.1 because 2.46.5
# publishes no cp315 wheel. CI runs this lock on CPython 3.15.0. A
# free-threaded 3.15 build is outside this lock: cryptography 50.0.1
# publishes no cp315t wheel.
# No source builds. No fitr runtime dependency.
--index-url https://pypi.org/simple
--only-binary :all:
